summary: VinFast Auto Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) on October 13, 2026, disclosing preliminary September 2026 Vietnam EV deliveries of 23,624 units, up 17% month-over-month, with year-to-date deliveries of 177,697 units and roughly 20,000 monthly average. The VF 3 led at 6,474 units. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanic appears. This is an operational monthly sales metric, not a special situation; watch delivery-to-revenue recognition and audit adjustments.
